🧵 Deutsche Bank bereitet Bitcoin-Verwahrung vor—der Krypto-Tresor zieht ins Bankensystem ein

Die Deutsche Bank plant, institutionellen Kunden die Verwahrung von Bitcoin und Ether anzubieten.

tweets.text: If banks become the default custodians, Bitcoin and Ether could come to look like any other holding in a securities account, with bank-level oversight and probably bank-level costs. That could narrow the gap between crypto and traditional finance.
